must.title: Security Compliance
must.description: Ensure the system complies with security standards.
must.metric: Pass all security audits with no critical vulnerabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Security audits must be conducted quarterly.
All critical vulnerabilities must be resolved within 30 days.
Security patches must be applied within 7 days of release.

must.title: Reliability
must.description: Ensure system reliability with minimal downtime.
must.metric: System uptime must be 99.9% over a rolling 30-day window.
acceptance_criteria: System must recover automatically from failures.
Reliability metrics must be monitored and reported.

should.title: Performance Under Load
should.description: The system must maintain performance under expected load conditions.
should.metric: System response time must be under 2 seconds at peak load.
acceptance_criteria: Load tests must simulate peak conditions.
System must not exceed 2 seconds response time.
Performance metrics must be logged and reviewed.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99

should.title: Scalability
should.description: The system must scale to support increased user load.
should.metric: Support 100% increase in user load without performance degradation.
acceptance_criteria: Scalability tests must simulate double the current user load.
System must maintain performance metrics under increased load.
should.verification: Scalability test with 2× current user load

should.title: Usability
should.description: Ensure the system is user-friendly and accessible.
should.metric: User satisfaction score must be above 80%.
acceptance_criteria: Conduct usability tests with target users.
